## Scientific Question

How can compact non-abelian gauge subalgebras aligned with the Standard Model ($\mathfrak{su}(3) \oplus \mathfrak{su}(2) \oplus \mathfrak{u}(1)$) and Pati–Salam ($\mathfrak{su}(4) \cong \mathfrak{so}(6)$) emerge from discrete procedural symmetries acting on the 240 roots of the exceptional $E_8$ lattice?

## Algebraic & Computational Summary

The repository [`E8-Cycle-Clock-Analysis`](https://github.com/macielamaral/E8-Cycle-Clock-Analysis) investigates a "Fast Pointer, Slow Clicker" procedural clock acting on a 10-shell decomposition of the $E_8$ root system [@amaral2025e8clock]:

1. **Clock Components:** Generated by two non-commuting elements in $\mathrm{Spin}(8)$—a $C_5$ rotational pointer $s$ and a $C_4$ bridging clicker $\sigma$—whose combined action traverses the 10 shells transitively.
2. **Stabilizer Subalgebras in $\mathfrak{spin}(8)$:** Symbolic and numerical linear-algebra scripts compute the Lie-algebra centralizers/stabilizers inside $\mathfrak{spin}(8)$ ($\dim \mathfrak{spin}(8) = 28$):
   $$
   \operatorname{Stab}(s) \cong \mathfrak{su}(3) \quad (\dim = 8), \qquad
   \operatorname{Stab}(\sigma) \cong \mathfrak{u}(4) \quad (\dim = 16),
   $$
   with a 3-dimensional intersection
   $$
   \operatorname{Stab}(s) \cap \operatorname{Stab}(\sigma) \cong \mathfrak{su}(2) \quad (\dim = 3).
   $$
3. **Gauge Unification Context:** Isolating $\mathfrak{u}(4)$ ($\supset \mathfrak{su}(4)$ Pati–Salam lepton-as-fourth-color algebra) together with $\mathfrak{su}(3)$ and $\mathfrak{su}(2)$ provides a concrete discrete-geometric laboratory connecting root-lattice dynamics to gauge symmetry breaking.
